PASS transitively. eval.runner.build_workflow_command targets the exact run.py whose __main__ now routes through run_spec_from_args -> execute_cli_args -> WorkflowRunner, launched via subprocess.Popen. HONEST NUANCE: eval reaches WorkflowRunner through the run.py subprocess boundary, not by importing WorkflowRunner in-process (eval.runner has no such import) -- deliberate process isolation, characterized by these tests, not a direct call.
